results.title: How Facebook's Algorithmic Tweaks Affected Engagement with News URLs over Time
results.snippet: An in-depth media summary on Axel Bruns's Snurblog detailing a presentation delivered by Fabio Giglietto at the 2026 International Communication Association (ICA) conference in Cape Town. The coverage explores Giglietto's research on how Facebook's algorithmic shifts impact the audience reach and amplification of news URLs depending on partisan sharing intensity and journalistic quality.

results.title: Research Radio on Apple Podcasts
results.snippet: An AI-generated audio podcast curated by Fabio Giglietto. The show features deep-dive discussions into computational social science research, platform data governance, and online disinformation. The series is developed using curated papers, scripts generated with Anthropic's Claude, and narration from Google Gemini.

results.title: Who is behind vera.ai? Meet the people and teams that make up the vera.ai project. #8 Team of University of Urbino Carlo Bo
results.snippet: An interview-style media feature profiling the University of Urbino Carlo Bo's research team. Led by Fabio Giglietto, the team discusses their leadership role in Work Package 4 of the European vera.ai project, which focuses on detecting coordinated sharing behaviors on social media and addressing the challenges of AI-generated disinformation.
